title: OpsWeave Telemetry Event v1
description: A normalized automation Event. The workspace is authoritative only when the Kernel resolves sourceId in its registry; the body value is a consistency check. payloadDigest covers the canonical payload bytes and never makes the payload Evidence.

nativeId.description: Stable upstream Trigger/Event identifier (for Zabbix, the eventid).

sourceId.description: Telemetry source registered by the Kernel; determines workspace and plugin.

workspaceId.description: Must match the Kernel registry; a mismatch is rejected, never trusted.

occurredAt.description: When the upstream event happened. Out-of-order values are allowed and marked late.

observedAt.description: When the plugin observed the event; used for latency bounds, not identity.

payloadDigest.description: sha256 of canonical UTF-8 payload JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace); the Kernel recomputes it.

payload.description: Bounded upstream fields used for display and digest only; never stored as Evidence.

recurrenceOf.description: Set only by the Kernel when a new PROBLEM follows a closed incident.
